instruction: Using the nodejs/node GitHub Releases interface, identify the newest release marked Latest and the newest release whose title or notes identify it as LTS. Open both release pages and report tag, title, publication date, author, whether each is a prerelease, the first three named notable changes shown, and the number of assets displayed. Explain whether the Latest release is also the newest LTS release. Use only visible GitHub UI and do not sign in or download assets.
